newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian stocks up edge up led by cement.
newsitem.headline: Colombian stocks up edge up led by cement.

text.p: BOGOTA, April 28 Reuter - Colombian stocks edged up slightly Monday in sluggish sessions led by a rise in cement producer Cementos Paz del Rio.
Bogota's IBB index was up 0.18 percent to 1,132.32 on volume of 1.5 billion pesos, while Medellin's IBOMED general price index gained 0.09 percent to close at 17,352.76 on 2.6 billion peso volume.
"Stocks didn't really do much today because of the lack of demand from foreign funds. There was quite a lot of rumour- mongering though," one Bogota trader said.

Cementos Paz del Rio, part of which belongs to the Sindicato Antioqueno industrial conglomerate, was one of the day's biggest gainers. It was up 6.79 percent at 1,100 in Bogota and up 4.23 percent at 1,110 in Medellin.
The rise was driven by speculation about the imminent issue of 1.6 million shares authorized at the annual shareholders' assembly.
Iron and steel manufacturer Acerias Paz del Rio rose 6.6 percent to 80 centavos in Bogota and was up 9.5 percent to the same price in Medellin.
Banco de Colombia rose on unconfirmed rumours of a possible merger with a foreign group. It gained 1.31 percent to 385 in Bogota and 1.58 percent to the same price in Medellin.
The bank failed in its bid to tie up a deal with Spain's Banco Central Hispano Americano in mid-April -- news which pushed share prices down to 374.
Gains were paired by falls in brewing giant Bavaria of 0.37 percent to 7,920 in Bogota and 0.5 percent to 7,910 in Medellin.
